<div class="about-text">

<h2>Marketing with a creative perspective.</h2>

<p>
My interests are primarily in entertainment and sports marketing, with a particular interest in how brands, media companies, teams, and organizations connect with audiences.
</p>

<p>
My experience at Cal Poly Pomona has allowed me to explore marketing from several perspectives, including consumer behavior, research, entertainment marketing, social media, journalism, and multimedia storytelling.
</p>

<p>
Outside the classroom, I've developed leadership and business experience through Alpha Kappa Psi, where I serve as President. I've also participated in student consulting projects and created social media content for the organization.
</p>

<p>
I'm especially interested in opportunities where strategy and creativity overlap — whether that's developing a campaign, understanding an audience, creating digital content, or telling a story through media.
</p>
